mk-3Unt.title: City: large apartment blocks
mk-3Unt.summary: Large apartment buildings and tall blocks almost always mean the capital, Skopje, the biggest city by far.

mk-BJh9.title: Pole: long rectangular lamps
mk-BJh9.summary: Long, rectangular street lamps are only found in one city, Prilep.

mk-BqvX.title: Obituary: thick light blue border
mk-BqvX.summary: A death notice poster with a thick light blue border is only found in Kumanovo.

mk-CyWV.title: Obituary: tall, blue, cross above border
mk-CyWV.summary: Tall blue posters, with the cross above the border. Veles has the most variety and never has the corner pattern of Strumica.

mk-F1Jf.title: Obituary: tall, black, two cross styles
mk-F1Jf.summary: Tall black posters, with either a cross above the border or a thick cross inside a gap in it. This points to Tetovo.

mk-F1TE.title: Coverage: older Gen 3 only on highways
mk-F1TE.summary: The older Gen 3 coverage is sparse, mostly along some highways and in eight main cities such as Skopje, Bitola and Ohrid.

mk-FsbE.title: Pole: Greek lamps on utility poles
mk-FsbE.summary: Small lamps mounted on utility poles, nicknamed Greek lamps. Greece and Serbia have them too.

mk-GLwG.title: Obituary: wide, red or blue, cross under border
mk-GLwG.summary: Wide posters in red or blue. A red one with the cross below the border points to Ohrid, since no other city does this.

mk-Gary.title: Sign: yellow direction signs, two scripts
mk-Gary.summary: Yellow direction signs write town names in both Latin and Cyrillic letters. Serbia is the only similar country that also does this.

differs.how: Also uses two scripts, so harder to separate

mk-HFWt.title: Kerbs: black and yellow stripes
mk-HFWt.summary: Black and yellow striped kerbs most likely mean Strumica. They are rare in Skopje, and around roundabouts they likely mean Tetovo.

mk-IeVN.title: Obituary posters: each city has its own style
mk-IeVN.summary: Death notice posters on utility poles look different in each city. Learn the colour, direction and cross position for each city.

mk-NOTA.title: Landscape: dry grass, small hills
mk-NOTA.summary: Dry grassland with small hills and a few scattered trees.

mk-RmZb.title: Obituary: wide, blue, cross breaks the border
mk-RmZb.summary: Wide (horizontal) posters in light or dark blue, with the cross sitting in a gap of the border. This points to Bitola.

mk-Tm7m.title: Landscape: large city beside a lake
mk-Tm7m.summary: A big town right next to a lake is Ohrid, the only large city on a lake.

mk-VYOQ.title: Plate: white with a red block on the left
mk-VYOQ.summary: White plates, sometimes with the blue EU strip, always with a clear red block near the left edge. Serbia almost always has the blue strip.

differs.how: Serbian plates almost always have the blue strip

mk-dKOW.title: Guardrail: A-profile with red reflectors
mk-dKOW.summary: The common European A-profile guardrail, with a smooth wave shape and red reflectors. Serbia uses the B-profile instead.

mk-f8ti.title: Obituary: tall, blue, fancy corner pattern
mk-f8ti.summary: Tall (vertical) blue posters with an intricate pattern in the corner. Only Strumica has that pattern.

mk-jQXp.title: Bollard: thin round or wedge, red reflector
mk-jQXp.summary: Two white bollards: a very thin rounded one and a wedge-shaped one, both with a red or white reflector on a black panel. Croatia has the same wedge.

differs.how: Hungary's wedge has more white space above the black panel

mk-k3sg.title: Language: Cyrillic with Ѓ and Ќ
mk-k3sg.summary: Macedonian is written in Cyrillic. Road signs add Latin letters, but most other signs are only Cyrillic. Ѓ and Ќ are only used in Macedonian.

mk-kkO5.title: Landscape: two very rocky hills
mk-kkO5.summary: Two bare, very rocky hills that show up in parts of Prilep.

mk-lNYT.title: Google car: small low blur, Gen 4 smallcam
mk-lNYT.summary: The newer Gen 4 coverage uses a smallcam, mounted lower than usual. You see a fairly big round blur with a small bump at the front, sometimes see-through. Most of the Balkans has it.

mk-lY5z.title: Google car: never has an antenna
mk-lY5z.summary: The older Gen 3 car here never shows an antenna. Other European countries sometimes show one, though car shots with no antenna also exist elsewhere. Serbia rarely has one.

differs.how: Serbia mostly has no antenna but sometimes shows one

mk-lm-2586.title: Camera: dirt smudges on the lens
mk-lm-2586.summary: In the south and east, some roads show recognisable smudges on the camera, like a large dead insect on one road or a few brown spots near the left. Learn them for exact routes.

mk-lm-740910.title: Landscape: mountains north and south
mk-lm-740910.summary: Mountains stand to the north and south of the capital. The northern one is bigger and often shows a cross on top.

mk-oHPQ.title: Google car: green truck behind the car
mk-oHPQ.summary: In older Gen 3 coverage, a green truck is seen behind the car along part of the E-65 road, between two towns in the west. Mostly out of date.

mk-v0r9.title: Obituary: tall, black, open border
mk-v0r9.summary: Tall black posters where the border does not fully surround the poster. That gap makes Prilep easy to spot.

mk-wBz4.title: Sign: yellow-filled warning triangles
mk-wBz4.summary: Warning signs have a yellow fill inside the red border, while most of Europe uses white. Greece also commonly has yellow ones, and Slovenia sometimes does.

differs.how: Only sometimes yellow, and not as common
